description: The FLORA plugin lets users generate, organize, and iterate on visual assets — hero images, moodboards, lifestyle shots, promo graphics — directly from a conversation. When used alongside other connected tools like Notion, Google Drive, or Slack, the same conversation can pull in context and write results back to where the team already works. Authentication is OAuth via your existing FLORA account.

defaultPrompt: Generate a clean PDP shot in FLORA for each item in my product list.
Design a character, then lock the design and give me six angles.
Design a wine bar poster, place it on four sites, add social sizes and a contact sheet.
